“没办法谁让你是实力加颜值担当。”

王鹏飞耸肩，“这种事绝对轮不到我身上。我当初大二选专业脑子抽了才会选纯艺类综画。你们几个大一的小姑娘可得谨慎哈！不是顾枫这样的天才，都别学！”

“说什么浑话，哪儿有这么夸张！”

顾枫笑骂。

“哪门作业少我就选哪一门！”陈雨洁第一个表明态

听他这么一说，现场的所有人注意力也都缓缓转向赵曜。十全师傅和及第师傅自然也都没有落下。

“你说什么？”不等唐景星话说完，陈慕阳已经起身冷眼看向了唐景星。

“我还以为你这幻象都多强呢，不过区区纸老虎罢了。”苏尘对着雕红杉爽朗的大笑两声，眼神中充满了轻蔑。

同时，眼神也是略带深意的，朝着其他脉系的杨家人，望了几眼。

“没错，若不是有曹前辈在，或许难度要更大！”唐冉生也是苦笑着道。

"There is no way you can be responsible for your strength and appearance."

Wang Pengfei shrugged, "This kind of thing will never happen to me. When I was a sophomore, I chose a pure arts variety show because I was so brainless. You freshmen girls should be careful! If you are not a genius like Gu Feng, don't learn it!"

"What nonsense are you talking about? How can it be so exaggerated!"

Gu Feng laughed and scolded.

"I will choose whichever subject has less homework!" Chen Yujie was the first to express her attitude.

After hearing what he said, everyone at the scene slowly turned their attention to Zhao Yao.Naturally, Master Shiquan and Master Jidi were not left behind either.

"What did you say?" Before Tang Jingxing could finish speaking, Chen Muyang had already stood up and looked at Tang Jingxing coldly.

"I thought your illusion was so powerful, but it's just a paper tiger." Su Chen laughed heartily at the redwood tree, his eyes filled with contempt.

At the same time, his eyes were also slightly meaningful, and he glanced at the Yang family members of other lineages.

"That's right, if it weren't for Senior Cao here, it might be even more difficult!" Tang Ransheng also said with a wry smile.
